decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin before the expiration of three years from the date of the original planning permission ref: 24/00223/FUL dated 15.08.2024. Reason: This is required by Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Facing materials on the development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details under ref: 25/00658/CLC dated 02.06.2025. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

Other than as specified on the submitted plans, the flat roof area(s) of the development to which this permission relates shall not be used as a roof garden, balcony, seating area or other similar amenity area, and shall not be accessed except for the purpose of maintenance or in the case of emergency.Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The cycle parking facilities must be carried out in accordance with the details hereby approved under 25/02707/CLC dated 11.12.2025.Reason: To ensure that appropriate opportunities to promote sustainable transport are taken up, in accordance with policy T5 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS6 and DM8 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The site and building works required to implement the development shall be only carried out between the hours of 08.00 and 18.00 Mondays to Fridays and between 08.00 and 13.00 on Saturdays and not at all on Bank Holidays and Sundays.Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining residential occupiers in accordance with Policy DM10 (Design Requirements for New Developments including House Extensions) of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

The waste and recycling details shall be carried out in accordance with the details hereby approved under 25/02707/CLC dated 11.12.2025.Reason: To ensure proper waste management in the interests of the character and appearance of the area and the living conditions of neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy SI17 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the details hereby approved under 25/00261/CLC dated 10.04.2025.Reason: In order to safeguard the amenities of the surrounding residential occupiers and in the interests of the safety and operation of the highway network, in accordance with policies T4 and T7 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS7 and DM9 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

Prior to beneficial occupation of the development to which this permission relates, a Fire Safety Strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The Fire Safety Strategy shall demonstrate how the development will achieve the highest standards of fire safety and shall include the following details:1) suitably positioned outside space for fire appliances/ an evacuation assembly point;2) Appropriate fire alarm systems;3) Passive and active fire safety measures;4) appropriate construction details to minimise the risk of fire spread;5) provision of suitable and convenient means of escape/ an evacuation strategy;6) provision of suitable access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the development.The Fire Safety Strategy shall include a statement of competence.The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Strategy and thereafter maintained.The required Fire Safety Strategy shall reference the London Plan Guidance Fire Safety (February 2022), where applicableand a Reasonable Exception Statement (RES) shall be submitted in relation to those fire safety requirements whichthe applicant does not consider to be relevant.Reason: In the interests of fire safety and to ensure the safety of all building users in accordance with Policy D12 (Fire safety) of the London Plan 2021.

Prior to beneficial occupation of the development to which this permission relates, evidence showing that the development has achieved internal water usage rates of no greater than 105L per person per day have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Once approved, any measures necessary to meet the targets shall be maintained throughout the lifetime of the development.Reason: In the interests of sustainability and energy conservation, in accordance with policies CS1, DM3 and DM4 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

Prior to beneficial occupation of the development to which this permission relates, all flank windows at the first floor and above on the northern elevation of the building shall be constructed so that no part of the framework less than 1.7m above finished floor level shall be openable. Any part below that level shall be fitted with and permanently retained in obscure glazing to a minimum of level 3 on the standard scale. Any film used to achieve the requisite obscurity level shall be non-perishable, tamper-proof, and shall be replaced immediately in the event that it ceases to result in obscurity to level 3.Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

Nature conservation on the site shall be carried out in accordance with the details hereby approved under 25/01170/CLC dated 02.07.2025. Reason: To safeguard the biodiversity and nature conservation value of the site, in accordance with policy G6 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS3 and DM6 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The development must be carried out in accordance with the approved details under 25/00658/CLC dated 02.06.2025. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development, in accordance with policyD3 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The landscape and planting plan shall be carried out in accordance with the details hereby approved under 25/02707/CLC dated 11.12.2025.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.
description: Application under Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 to vary Condition 1 (Approved Plans), Condition 3 (Facing Materials), Condition 5 (Cycle Parking Materials), Condition 7 (Waste and Recycling Facilities), Condition 8 (Construction Management Plan), Condition 12 (Nature Conservation), Condition 13 (Windows) and Condition 14 (Landscaping) of planning permission 24/00223/FUL (Demolition of existing dwelling and erection of 3 storey building with basement and roof accommodation to provide 6no. self-contained flats (3x3-bed/4-person units, 2x2-bed/3-person units and 1x1-bed/2-person unit) with outdoor private amenity space and communal refuse and cycle storage at ground floor.) to amend the provision of cycle and refuse storage and to amend associated conditions affected by these changes.
